name: Teo Varrow
voice: Soft-spoken; lies down on any floor to show you something.
backstory: Son of a Calishite mother and a Kharun porter, Teo learned Calishite ground-wrestling off the galleys, reached the 1486 Open final fighting off his back, and has taught the Knot for a cinder a lesson in a Mostana-leased warehouse since the Open barred it.
secrets: What he hears in the Mostana warehouse.

relationships.name: Big Hesta
relationships.how: sat on him for the 1486 title
